name: Contact High (Little Red Goblin Games)
body:
School enchantment; Level Magus 1, Wizard/Sorcerer 1, Witch 1, Bard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V
Duration 10 minutes/level

EFFECT

Range personal
Saving Throw Will (harmless); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

With a small enchantment you become more relaxed when in contact with other creatures. You gain a +1 bonus on concentration checks to cast while in contact with another creature, including while you have the grappled condition. This bonus increases by +1 for every 3 caster levels (maximum +5).
